title: Experimental and theoretical investigations of Erbium complex: DNA/BSA interaction, anticancer and antibacterial studies.
authors: Thanoon, Raid D; Ibadi, Emam Atiyah; Ahmad, Irfan; Alamir, Hassan Thoulfikar A; Alwan, Marim; Hashim, Furqan S; Khaled, Donia Waleed; Alkhafaji, Adnan Taan; Asiri, Mohammed; Alsaalamy, Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铒配合物与DNA/BSA的相互作用，涉及光谱实验和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸/蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主、建模为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: To assess the biological potential of an Er complex that contains a 2,2'-bipyridine ligand, various techniques such as multispectral and molecular modeling procedures were utilized to examine its DNA-binding ability, BSA binding affinity, antimicrobial effects, and anticancer properties. By analyzing fluorescent information and employing the vant' Hoff equation, important parameters such as the innate docking coefficient (K(b)), Stern-Volmer coefficient (K(SV)), and thermodynamic properties including modifications in liberated energy (DeltaG degrees ), enthalpy (∆H degrees ), and entropy (∆S degrees ) were determined. The trial findings suggest that the compound can bind to DNA, primarily through groove binding. Additionally, the engagement between the Er compound and the protein BSA was examined using emission spectroscopy technique, revealing a powerful binding affinity between the compound and BSA. The Er complex binds to BSA primarily via hydrogen links and van der Waals forces, as indicated by the adverse values of DeltaH degrees  and ∆S degrees . Through a static quenching process, the complex significantly reduces the intrinsic fluorescence of BSA. Molecular binding calculations and rivalrous binding trials confirm that this compound dock to hydrophobic remains found in site III of BSA. Additionally, the Er complex demonstrates promising results in terms of its anticancer and antimicrobial activities based on screening tests.
abstract_zh: 为评估含2,2'-联吡啶配体的Er配合物的生物潜力，采用多光谱和分子建模程序等多种技术，考察了其DNA结合能力、BSA结合亲和力、抗菌效果及抗癌特性。通过分析荧光信息并运用范特霍夫方程，确定了内在对接系数（K(b)）、斯特恩-沃尔默系数（K(SV)）以及热力学性质，包括自由能变化（DeltaG degrees）、焓变（∆H degrees）和熵变（∆S degrees）等重要参数。试验结果表明，该化合物主要通过沟槽结合方式与DNA结合。此外，利用发射光谱技术研究了Er化合物与蛋白质BSA之间的相互作用，揭示出该化合物与BSA之间具有强结合亲和力。DeltaH degrees 和∆S degrees 的负值表明，Er配合物主要通过氢键和范德华力与BSA结合。通过静态猝灭过程，该配合物显著降低了BSA的内源荧光。分子对接计算和竞争性结合试验证实，该化合物对接至BSA位点III中的疏水残基。此外，基于筛选测试，Er配合物在抗癌和抗菌活性方面展现出有前景的结果。
